title: Kusama Dots
description: A breathing field of polka dots in the spirit of Yayoi Kusama's dot paintings and Infinity rooms: a lattice of circles whose sizes ripple from a slow noise field and pulse outward in radial waves, on her signature high-contrast palettes (red/white, yellow/black, pink/red, black/white, and a multicolour option). It's a generative homage rather than a copy of any single work — the pattern is procedural and endless. A Nets mode inverts the idea into her infinity-net look, where the dots become the gaps in a painted mesh. Density, dot size, size variation, wave depth and speed, jitter, rotation and breathing are live params; beats send a pulse rolling through the field.
